keys: # 第 2 周建造教学的【界面·教学】提示（文案 04_第2周.md），地球画面负责显示。剧情台词以后也加在这里。

zh: 目标：让废墟重新变得能住人。每片区域有四项恢复度：废墟清理、供电、水源、植被。
en: Goal: make the ruins livable again. Each area has four recovery levels: ruins cleared, power, water, plants.

zh: 俯视时，由你规划建筑、安排机器人施工；第三人称时，你操控 ARK-01 亲自走动、查看、拆小件、做修理。
en: In top view, you plan buildings and send robots to work. In third person, you drive ARK-01 to walk, look around, cut small scrap and repair.

zh: {girl}在课上学到的本领，决定了这里能修什么、能建什么。
en: What {girl} learns in class decides what can be repaired and built here.

zh: 施工机器人每周能干的活有限，用"工作单位"表示。施工要消耗工作单位；走动、查看、拆小件不消耗。
en: The robots can only do so much each week, counted in work units. Construction uses work units; walking, looking and cutting small scrap don't.

zh: 施工不会马上完成，点"结束本周"时统一结算。
en: Construction doesn't finish right away. It's all settled when you click End Week.

zh: 本周目标：清理维修站前的广场
en: This week's goal: clear the plaza in front of the repair station

zh: WASD 移动镜头，滚轮缩放，按住右键旋转。
en: WASD to move the camera, mouse wheel to zoom, hold right mouse to rotate.

zh: 右上角是本周剩下的工作单位：{units}。
en: The work units left this week are shown at the top right: {units}.

zh: 按 V 切换到第三人称，操控 ARK-01。
en: Press V to switch to third person and drive ARK-01.

zh: WASD 移动，空格越过障碍，E 交互。
en: WASD to move, Space to hop over obstacles, E to interact.

zh: Tab 打开工具轮盘，选择切割头。
en: Press Tab to open the tool wheel and pick the cutter.

zh: 按 V 回到俯视。选中广场上的废墟，点"清理"。
en: Press V to go back to top view. Select the ruins on the plaza and click Clear.

zh: 施工会一直进行到本周结束，点"结束本周"时完成。
en: Work continues until the end of the week and finishes when you click End Week.

zh: 本周还剩 {units} 个工作单位。可以继续安排施工，也可以四处看看，或者直接结束本周。
en: You have {units} work units left this week. Keep building, look around, or end the week.

zh: {player}，早上好！
en: Good morning, {player}!

zh: 你猜怎么着？方舟给我发了一个新游戏！叫《重建计划》！
en: Guess what? The ark sent me a new game! It's called Rebuild Plan!

zh: 主界面多了一个按钮：小镇
en: A new button appeared on the main screen: Town

zh: 里面是地球上一个好久没人住的小镇，坏掉了。我们要指挥机器人把它修好！
en: It's an old town on Earth where nobody's lived for ages. It's broken. We get to command robots to fix it!

zh: 等我长大回地球，就知道怎么修啦！
en: So when I grow up and go back to Earth, I'll know how to fix things!

zh: 这就是我的小镇！现在破破烂烂的，以后会很漂亮的！
en: This is my town! It's all broken now, but it'll be beautiful later!

zh: 那两个小机器人会帮我们干活，可是它们一周只能干这么多。
en: Those two little robots will work for us, but they can only do this much a week.

zh: 这个是 ARK-01，我们的小帮手！你来开，我帮你看路！
en: This is ARK-01, our little helper! You drive, I'll watch the road!

zh: 用切割头！对准那根歪掉的钢管，按住 E！
en: Use the cutter! Aim at that bent steel pipe and hold E!

zh: 金属 +1（第 3 块另外加 电子元件 +1）
en: Metal +1 (the 3rd piece also gives Electronics +1)

zh: 哇！拆下来了！
en: Wow! It came off!

zh: 一块一块拆好慢呀……整个广场要拆到什么时候嘛？
en: Cutting them one by one is so slow... When will we ever finish the whole plaza?

zh: 清理广场废墟：需要 2 个工作单位，获得 金属 +8、电子元件 +2。
en: Clear plaza ruins: costs 2 work units, gives Metal +8, Electronics +2.

zh: 小块的我们自己拆，大块的给机器人。这叫分工！
en: We cut the small bits ourselves and give the big ones to the robots. That's teamwork!

zh: 嗯嗯，就这样！
en: Mm-hm, just like that!

zh: 下周小镇目标：修好维修站里的第 3 台施工机器人（需要 机械 10）
en: Next week's town goal: repair the 3rd construction robot in the repair station (needs Mechanics 10)

zh: 门里面趴着的那个机器人，下周我们把它修好吧！
en: The robot lying inside the door... let's fix it next week!

zh: 结束本周？没用完的工作单位不会保留。
en: End the week? Unused work units won't carry over.

zh: {player}，你看我画的！
en: {player}, look what I drew!

zh: 这是修好以后的维修站。门是好的，灯是亮的，旁边还有一棵树！
en: This is the repair station after we fix it. The door works, the lights are on, and there's a tree next to it!

zh: 档案课说，以前的人会给以后的自己写信。
en: Archive class said people long ago wrote letters to their future selves.

zh: 我也要录一个，给明天的我！
en: I want to record one too, for tomorrow's me!

zh: ● 录音中
en: ● Recording

zh: 明天的我，你好！我是今天的我。
en: Hello, tomorrow's me! This is today's me.

zh: 今天我和{player}把广场打扫干净了。
en: Today {player} and I cleaned up the plaza.

zh: 今天我和{player}去看了小镇，有好多好多石头。
en: Today {player} and I went to see the town. There were so many rocks.

zh: 游戏里的小镇，我会把它修好的。真的地球，等我长大了也要修好！
en: I'll fix the town in the game. And the real Earth, I'll fix it too when I grow up!

zh: {player}，你也说一句嘛！
en: {player}, you say something too!

zh: 哈哈，{player}好啰嗦！
en: Haha, {player} nags so much!

zh: 嘿嘿，那我以后画更多！
en: Hehe, then I'll draw even more!

zh: 嗯！拉钩！
en: Mm! Pinky promise!

zh: 录进去啦！明天的我会听到的！
en: It's recorded! Tomorrow's me will hear it!

zh: 以后我每年都录一段！
en: I'll record one every year from now on!

zh: ……晚安，{player}。
en: ...Good night, {player}.

zh: 第 3 周
en: Week 3

zh: 明天的你，也要好好吃饭。
en: Tomorrow's you should eat well too.

zh: 你画得真好看。
en: Your drawing is really nice.

zh: 我们一起把它变成画里的样子。
en: Let's make it look like the picture together.
